actions.action: Measure distance from light to top leaves
Raise light fixture if too close
Check soil moisture 2 inches deep with finger
Water if soil is dry at 2 inches
Test runoff pH with pen or drop kit
Adjust feed water pH if out of range
Feed balanced nutrient at half label strength
Alternatively add cal-mag at label dose if interveinal yellowing
Share close-up photo, light model/height and feed schedule if problem persists

reason: The answer offers nutrient deficiency only as one of two equally weighted causes, alongside light stress. Feeding comes last, after light and pH checks, and is conditional and at half strength, so the fix is present but buried. Nothing recommended is likely to harm the plant.
